FAQ

Common questions customers ask

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. Call or text ARwash SVCs for a free estimate on detailing and exterior cleaning services.

Do you come to the customer?

Yes. Mobile service is one of the biggest advantages of working with ARwash SVCs.

Can I text photos for a quote?

Yes. Sending pictures of the vehicle, driveway, house, or building can speed up your quote.

What is soft washing?

Soft washing uses a lower-pressure method that is safer for delicate exterior surfaces than high-pressure washing alone.
